notes: Taxes and regulatory fees are excluded everywhere; every carrier bills them on top.
One retail price per phone. Apple, T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon list the same figure (carriers show it as $x.99); Xfinity does not publish one, so Apple's is used everywhere.

T-Mobile prices include the $5/line AutoPay discount. AT&T prices are after the AutoPay + paperless billing discount. Xfinity prices include the $10/mo Xfinity Internet customer discount and require residential Xfinity Internet.

Verizon prices are after the Auto Pay + paper-free billing discount ($10/line more without). myPlan 1- and 2-line figures follow the May 2026 Unlimited Ultimate increase (+$5); 3- and 4+-line standard rates are from Verizon's plan page, and the $10/mo account credit it gives new 3+-line accounts for 36 months is applied when switching. Simplicity is one flat price per line; its $15/line switch discount has no published end date and is applied for the whole term. Simplicity Pro ($50/mo on top, phone installment credited, phone returned every year) is a lease, not a purchase, so it is not a route. Verizon's $40 activation/upgrade fee is waived with the free Loyalty opt-in and is counted as $0. Costco sells no Verizon plans.
Bill-credit promotions pay out monthly over the term. Leaving early forfeits the remaining credits and the device balance is due.
Trade-in value counts as a cost: when a promotion takes your old phone, its Apple Trade In estimate is added to the total so every route is compared on the same footing.

Mint Mobile is priced on its 12-month prepaid plans (the cheapest term). New customers pay $15/mo for the first 12 months on any plan ($180 upfront), then the regular 12-month rate. 3- and 6-month terms cost more per month and are not modeled.

Multi-line: plan prices are account totals per line count with AutoPay. T-Mobile and AT&T were read from their plan pages for 1–5 lines (T-Mobile Beyond to 8; Essentials 2.0 is shown only at 1, 3, 4 and 5 lines — the 4- and 5-line prices are its 4 Line Offer, Essentials Saver at 1 and 2). Xfinity, Tello and Mint charge the same per line, so those totals are per-line price × lines.

Xfinity's first-year price applies to one line per account; extra lines pay the regular rate. Mint's $15 new-customer year is applied to every line (family lines are priced like single 12-month lines).
T-Mobile promotions cover at most four discounted devices per account; phones beyond that pay full price.

Costco: member benefits read from Costco's AT&T and T-Mobile showcases on 2026-09-22. Shop Cards and prepaid Visa cards are counted at face value against the total. Costco sells no Xfinity, Tello or Mint plans.
